Criteria:
- Confirm the request is tied to an authorized client, household member, trustee, executor, or approved agent.
- Verify the impacted access type: client portal, custodian login, document vault, e-signature, secure email, or aggregation feed.
- Determine whether access should be restored, reset, limited, transferred, or revoked.
- Check for fraud indicators, unusual urgency, changed contact information, or mismatched identity details.
- Confirm whether any compliance hold, deceased-client process, divorce restriction, or power-of-attorney review applies.

Evidence to collect:
- Approved identity verification record or call note.
- Written request or secure message describing the access issue.
- Current contact information on file and any requested changes.
- Authorization documents if the requester is not the primary client.
- Screenshot or description of the error, excluding passwords or authentication codes.
- Confirmation of resolution and any access changes made.
